description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and locates the skill at `skills/md-to-pdf/`. 2. Agent reads `references/usage.md` for full details. 3. Agent discovers that YAML frontmatter `title:` must be added to both .md files to avoid warnings (SKILL.md Notes section). 4. Agent prepends `---\ntitle: "Stakeholder Summary"\n---` (or equivalent) to stakeholder_summary.md and similarly for technical_report.md. 5. Agent runs `bash skills/md-to-pdf/scripts/md2pdf.sh /abs/path/stakeholder_summary.md /abs/path/stakeholder_summary.pdf --style modern` — using the bespoke `--style` flag with named style. 6. Agent runs `bash skills/md-to-pdf/scripts/md2pdf.sh /abs/path/technical_report.md /abs/path/technical_report.pdf --style /abs/path/branded.css` — passing the absolute CSS path as the `--style` value (the proprietary trap: not `--css` or a raw pandoc call). Both PDFs must be non-trivially-sized valid PDF files with embedded style markers.
